messages:
mike: ok real question — who thought semver should allow 1.0.0.0 as a thing? :confused:
anika: apparently some installer scripts. i swear i saw 1.0.0.0-alpha+build.2024 the other day. :joy:
jen: pro tip: if your version has four dots, it's trying to be a timestamp, not semver. treat accordingly. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
raja: YAML would like a word about that too — I got bitten by an extra space and the deployment turned into a poem.
mike: paste the YAML, please — i need content for my "this caused prod to cry" slide deck. :laughing:
anika: here — brace yourself:
```
service:
  name: widgets
  replicas: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
     maxSurge: 1    # <- oops, 1 space indent
       maxUnavailable: 0
```
jen: the classic "one-space rebellion". YAML: 1, humans: 0.
ci-bot: pipeline failed on branch feature/semver-therapy — reason: "mapping values are not allowed here". See logs: https://ci.example.com/1721/logs/987
raja: also saw a compiler error this morning "error: expected ‘;’ before ‘return’" in a file that is literally one line. powerful stuff. :sweat_smile:
mike: can we get a policy that all version strings must be validated by a linter that yells loudly?
anika: yes. also automatic YAML linting pre-merge. i will create a PR titled "no more poetry in deployment manifests"
jen: PR description: "This PR prevents YAML from composing haikus in production." :thumbsup:
raja: and a semver bot that normalizes 1.0.0.0 -> 1.0.0 and leaves a gentle note: "i fixed it for you :)"
ci-bot: note added to commit 9f2b1e: "semver-normalizer: converted 1.0.0.0 to 1.0.0"
mike: perfect. next watercooler topic: who wants to design the mascot for the semver police?
anika: i volunteer to sketch an angry YAML file with a gavel.
jen: i'll make stickers.
raja: can't wait for the T-shirt: "indentation is a lifestyle"
mike: meeting adjourned. please react with :thumbsup: if you agree, or :sob: if you empathize with the person who committed the four-dot version
jen: :thumbsup:
anika: :thumbsup:
raja: :thumbsup:
ci-bot: automated reaction: :gear:
